title: 第1章 红杏出墙第2章
content_zh:
青石城，街道上。
一个衣衫残破的少年，提着一个药篓，他白色的衣衫都被血色染红，腿上满是泥泞，这般模样引起了不少人关注。
“这不是林家的林炎吗？”
“听说他半年前跟着城主府的镖局，前往大龙山运送物资，这应该是刚完成任务回来了。”
“大龙山？那可是一片不毛之地，居然去那种地方运送物资？他疯了吗？”
“还不是为了钱？这小子可是出了名的顾家好男人，疼老婆，为了让家里娇妻过上好日子，玩命的接任务赚钱，每次都做的危险的任务。”
“看他药篓里不少的灵药，多半就是为了给他未婚妻补身子用的。”
“啧，这些血灵芝我记得只有在悬崖绝壁才有，看来这小子为了老婆也是默默吃了不少苦头呢。”
“……”
听得四周邻里的议论，林炎的嘴角流露出一缕幸福的笑容：
“距离上次出门，已经一年半了啊，不知道青青想我了没有……”
三年前，他与陆青青一见钟情，两人坠入爱河，定下婚约。
虽然还没有完成婚礼，可林炎却已经将对方当成了自己的妻子般小心呵护。
为了让陆青青过上好日子，林炎一个人远走他乡，在外奋斗。
甚至一年半载才能回来一次。
并且，每次外出，都是跋山涉水，面临凶险，有时候几乎是从死人堆里爬出来的。
换做别人，根本吃不了这个苦。
可林炎，为了自己的女人能过上幸福的日子，哪怕自己辛苦点，也都未曾埋怨过分毫。
只是，林炎刚一回到林家，就遇到了让他鼻血喷张而又愤怒的一幕：
只见到烛火映照之下，房间内有着一男一女紧紧地拥抱在一起，并且他还有一阵急促的喘息与暧昧传来：

“龙哥，你终于来了，你已经好几天没有疼爱人家了呢~人家真是迫不及待想得到你的宠幸呢~”
那露骨透着极致暧昧的语气，让林炎感觉骨头都酥酥麻麻的，可是那声音却熟悉的让林炎心头颤抖。
这不是自己的未婚妻陆青青的声音么？
陆青青在跟谁说话？
这时一个男子声音响起：
“你这小骚货，又急了？你这么急着唤我来，就不怕被你的未婚夫知道了？”
“我可是听说镖局的护送任务已经完成了，恐怕要不了多久那家伙就回来了，到时候你怎么跟他说你怀孕的事情？”
林炎听得着声音，再次心头一颤，这不是他们林家的少主林龙的声音吗？
同时林龙的父亲还是林家大长老，可谓权势滔天。
只是，林龙怎么会出现在他的家里？
怀孕？
谁怀孕了？陆青青吗？
可他出门一年半未归，陆青青怎么会怀孕？
难道……林炎的心中顿时有种不妙之感。
“大不了等他回来就跟他欢好几次，假装意外怀孕呗，他那个不懂情趣的榆木脑袋，难不成还能猜到孩子不是他的？”
陆青青的声音再次传来，还带着几分嗤笑与不屑：
content_en:
Qingshi City, on the street.
A young man in tattered clothes was carrying a medicine basket. His white clothes were stained red with blood, and his legs were covered with mud. This appearance attracted a lot of attention.
"Isn't this Lin Yan from the Lin family?"
"I heard that he followed the escort agency of the City Lord's Mansion to deliver supplies to Dalong Mountain half a year ago. He should have just returned from completing the mission."
"Dalong Mountain? That's a barren land. You actually go to that kind of place to transport supplies? Is he crazy?"
"Isn't it just for money? This guy is well-known as a good family man who loves his wife. In order to let his beloved wife live a good life, he takes on missions to make money, and he does dangerous missions every time."
"Looking at the many elixirs in his medicine basket, they are probably for his fiancée's health."
"Tsk, I remember that these Blood Ganoderma can only be found on cliffs. It seems that this guy has suffered a lot silently for his wife."
"..."
Hearing the comments from the neighbors around him, a happy smile appeared on Lin Yan's lips:
"It's been a year and a half since I last went out. I wonder if Qingqing misses me..."
Three years ago, he and Lu Qingqing fell in love at first sight. The two fell in love and made an engagement.
Although the wedding has not yet been completed, Lin Yan has already taken good care of her as if she were his wife.
In order to let Lu Qingqing live a good life, Lin Yan went away from home alone and struggled outside.
I only come back once every year or so.
Moreover, every time I go out, I have to travel through mountains and rivers, face dangers, and sometimes almost crawl out of the dead.
Anyone else would not be able to endure this hardship.
But Lin Yan, in order for his woman to live a happy life, even if he worked hard, he never complained at all.
However, as soon as Lin Yan returned to the Lin family, he encountered a scene that made his nose bleed and become angry:
Under the candlelight, I saw a man and a woman hugging each other tightly in the room, and there was a burst of rapid breathing and ambiguity:
"Brother Long, you're finally here. You haven't loved me for several days~ I really can't wait to get your favor~"
The explicit and extremely ambiguous tone made Lin Yan feel his bones were numb, but the familiar voice made Lin Yan's heart tremble.
Isn't this the voice of his fiancée Lu Qingqing?
Who is Lu Qingqing talking to?
At this time a man's voice sounded:
"You little slut, are you in a hurry again? Are you so anxious to call me here, aren't you afraid that your fiancé will find out?"
"I heard that the escort mission of the escort agency has been completed. I'm afraid that guy will come back soon. How will you tell him about your pregnancy then?"
Lin Yan heard the voice and his heart trembled again. Isn't this the voice of Lin Long, the young master of the Lin family?
At the same time, Lin Long's father is also the eldest elder of the Lin family, and he is extremely powerful.
But, why did Lin Long show up at his home?
Pregnant?
Who is pregnant? Lu Qingqing?
But he hadn't returned after being away for a year and a half, so how could Lu Qingqing be pregnant?
Could it be... Lin Yan suddenly felt something bad in his heart.
"At worst, when he comes back, I'll have sex with him several times and pretend to be pregnant unexpectedly. With his stupid head that doesn't understand emotions, can he still guess that the child is not his?"
Lu Qingqing's voice came again, with a bit of sneer and disdain:
